Website privacy

Privacy notice.

This notice explains what information Shelton Linen & Uniform Services collects through this website, why we collect it, and the choices available to you.

Effective August 15, 2026

Information we collect

When you request a quote, use the planning estimator, ask about a plant tour, or contact us, you may provide:

  • Your name, business name, email address, and phone number.
  • Information about your goods, industry, weekly volume, route cadence, service needs, and account preferences.
  • Any additional information you choose to include in a message or notes field.

Our website and service providers may also receive basic technical information needed to operate and secure the site, such as IP address, browser type, device information, page URL, and submission time.

How we use information

We use submitted information to review commercial laundry needs, prepare planning ranges or account-specific quotes, respond to questions, arrange requested follow-up, improve website reliability, prevent abuse, and maintain appropriate business records.

Please do not submit payment-card information, government identification numbers, medical information, or other sensitive personal information through these forms.

Service providers and sharing

Quote submissions may be processed by Formspree. Planning-estimator and lead information may be processed by website hosting, security, and account-management providers acting for Shelton. These providers receive information only as needed to perform their services.

Shelton does not sell personal information or share it for cross-context behavioral advertising. We may disclose information when required by law, to protect rights or safety, or as part of a business transaction subject to appropriate safeguards.

Browser storage and external services

The pricing estimator and Services-to-Quote handoff may use temporary browser session storage to preserve your selections while you move between pages. This information normally clears when the browser session ends or after it is used.

The site does not currently use Shelton-operated advertising trackers and does not respond differently to browser Do Not Track signals. Some pages may request fonts, icons, or map resources from third-party services, which may receive standard network information.

Retention and security

We retain inquiry and account information only for as long as reasonably necessary to respond, provide requested services, maintain business and legal records, resolve disputes, and protect the site. The exact period depends on the type of inquiry and whether a commercial relationship is established.

We use reasonable administrative and technical safeguards. No method of internet transmission or storage is completely secure, so we cannot guarantee absolute security.

Your choices

You may ask about, correct, or request deletion of information you submitted by contacting Shelton. We may need to verify your identity and may retain information when required for legal, security, or legitimate business purposes.

Email info@sheltonlinenanduniform.com or call (619) 320-8703.

Children and external links

This commercial-services website is not directed to children under 13, and we do not knowingly collect personal information from children through it. Links to external websites are governed by those sites' own privacy practices.

Updates to this notice

We may update this notice when our website or practices change. The effective date above will show when the current version took effect. Questions about this notice may be sent to info@sheltonlinenanduniform.com.
